problem:
Consider the matrices given below. Find $\text{dim(Null}(A))+\text{dim(Null}(B))+\text{dim(Null}(C)).$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 7 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -7 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Dimension of the Null Space of a Matrix
